newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Aviation Aug load factor off.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Aviation Aug load factor off.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said its August passenger load factor declined 2.7 points to 45.4 percent from 48.1 percent.
It said available seat miles rose 9.8 percent to 61.1 million from 55.7 million, and revenue passenger miles advanced 3.5 percent to 27.7 million from 26.8 million.

Year to date, the carrier said, its load factor was off 0.2 points to 44.5 percent from 44.7 percent. Available seat miles gained 25.4 percent to 449.9 million from 358.8 million, and revenue passenger miles rose 24.9 percent to 200.0 million from 160.2 million.
